title: Leonard v. Pepsico — the Harrier advertisement
shortTitle: Leonard v. Pepsico — the Harrier advertisement
summary: The book’s advertisement example tests what a reasonable audience would understand as a serious commercial commitment.
notes: The Harrier offer was treated as a joke in its presentation. The notes compare its context, extreme disparity, catalog, and later changes to the advertisement with the farm-sale dispute. Price disparity here is evidence relevant to interpretation; it should not be confused with a general requirement of adequate consideration.
